title: Recommend a "watch next" link on every episode page.
text: In October, visitors moved on from an episode page 4.5 times per 100 episode page views, and direct visits that began on an episode page viewed 1.34 pages, against 2.2 for direct visits at the publishers in Chartbeat's data. Visits from social were close to the benchmark (1.28 against 1.4), so people arrive at a normal rate but stop after one episode. Recommend that whoever runs atm.media add two or three related episodes under each video, picked by program or by the guest's industry, with the next episode visible without scrolling. The Video section's moves per 100 page views will show whether it works.

title: Recommend a short highlight at the top of the long client-series pages.
text: Viewers watched 17% of each The Future of Growth video and 19% of each Full Frame video in October, against 47% for Moment Maker and a 50% benchmark for business videos of 2 to 10 minutes (Vidyard). Both series had few plays (22 and 18), so treat this as an early signal. Recommend testing a 60-second highlight or chapter links above the full episode on one page of each series, with the client's agreement, and comparing watch-through the month after.
